reviews.text:
New to, but LOVE THIS APP!!. I just got this app a little over a week ago, for many reasons, including the convenience of being able to read scripture + do devotionals from anywhere, without having to carry anything extra, + beautiful music + nature photos, that enhances the experience. I’d read mixed reviews b4 deciding to take a chance, + I’ve had no issues + have no complaints. I love how easy it is to share the scriptures to other social channels + the different categories you can choose to study! Great job!!
EDIT have had this app for over a yr + half, maybe 2 now, + still am Loving it!! Love all the different topics to do my studies on! Or can just choose morning or evening devotionals. Great job on the aesthetic + background music choices as well! Just Bravo!! Still not 1 issue with the app personally. Am about to share it on socials again, + recommend it in a new program in creating for women’s holistic health + wellness. Perfect for using before meditations too!

reviews.text: Jesus has perfect timing. I have been spending a lot of time reading the Bible and studying commentaries to help understand the passages. I have been using a certain website that gives me a verse of the day and I enjoy it very much. It gives me a prayer as well as an explanation of the verse. One day I was researching on the internet and I have no idea how I did but I ended up coming across this app. I really liked the name and so I decided to check it out. I also liked that it was created for women. When I downloaded the app I instantly knew that God was going to use this to make a big difference in my life. This year has been a huge struggle for me and God has been so faithful in delivering me and He’s using this app to continue to do so. It is so unique and special to me. I love everything about it especially the beautiful music and the graphics and of course the devotionals. The Holy Spirit really speaks to me in such an encouraging and gentle way through this app and I am filled with His peace and love. I am definitely going to share it with other women. Thank you for the awesome work that you’re doing to spread the Good News! To God be the glory!

reviews.text: Love the Devotional/Reflexion option. The developer misinformed about languages. Love being able to get new verses as many times as I would want on the same day, rather than being limited to only one, as majority of this type of apps work. Since verses sometimes don’t “speak” to us right away, I also love the option to read a brief explanation/reflexion of the verse. I am not giving a full 5 stars review, since the developer misinformed about the Languages in which this app is available. I was unable to find the option to read the verses in Spanish, which is something I was looking forward to and one of the reasons why I downloaded it. I’m very active in my parish in both idioms, English and Spanish, and was looking for an app to be able to share the same verse in both languages.
